summary: All date/time parsing moved into deskstats/timeparse.py and the other modules delegate to it; tests pass and tests/test_timeparse.py was added. Notes: the guide's table says chats should use TRUNCATE but section 2.3 and today's code use nearest-even, so I kept nearest-even; out-of-range/inf epochs and huge years now raise ValueError (a clean error) instead of OverflowError (a crash).
